name: Kami-sama o Korosu 102 no Houshiki
source:
An ordinary high school girl fights against evil spirits with a sword. She is bullied by sempai at school and is sexually harassed by the priest, but she believes she can still find her quiet happiness.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
